title.zh: 关闭存储空间的访问日志记录功能
title.en: Disable access log record for a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket的拥有者才有权限关闭Bucket访问日志记录功能。
- 如果目标Bucket没有开启访问日志记录功能，则返回参数显示204状态码。
descriptions.en:
- Only the bucket owner can perform a shutdown of the access log record feature for the bucket.
- If the target bucket does not have the access log record feature enabled, the parameter in the response returns a 204 status code.
